dataset_name: Cross-check: CMEMS OMI vs NSIDC G02135 Southern Hemisphere monthly extent
steps: Matched 548 months; mean OMI-NSIDC difference 0.369 10^6 km^2, r=0.9999

metrics.method: NSIDC daily values averaged to calendar months (months with >=10 daily values kept); joined to OMI on year-month. Products use different SIC algorithms (OSI SAF OSI-450/430 vs NASA Team), so differences are expected and the datasets are NOT merged.

outputs.description: Month-matched OMI vs NSIDC extent and difference
